caption: The referee who stops Rocky Golden's match with Jacob Jett on SWF Legends in June 2008 when Jett seems unconscious.

name: Louis Williams
caption: The SWF's Head of Production and a former manager in the SWF, who talks the creative meeting through the new stage and ramp on the eve of The Supreme Challenge 28.

name: Colin Kennedy
caption: The head of the Production Design department and a former SWF wrestler, who explains the new stage and ramp in the same meeting.

name: Amanda Eisen
caption: Richard Eisen's daughter, in her early twenties and at Brown, who has never had anything to do with the SWF; she talks Henry Miller with the narrator at the Eisen house and emails him about coffee.

name: Nevada Nuclear
caption: A heavily muscled, heavily tanned newcomer in a red tank top and dark sunglasses, whom SM York introduces on the ramp at The Supreme Challenge 28 as the biggest thing the SWF has ever seen; he beats Swoop McCarthy in his Supreme TV debut in Week 3 of July 2008, loses to Zimmy Bumfhole in Week 4, and tells the crowd in Week 2 of August that, with his winning streak over, it is time to get serious.

name: SM York
caption: A young woman with a reserved, bookish look who introduces Nevada Nuclear on the ramp at The Supreme Challenge 28 as a Supreme Legend in the making, then manages him on Supreme TV, screaming encouragement from outside the ring and speaking for him on the stage.

name: Adrian Garcia
caption: A small man in a suit, with a scroll and a large bodyguard behind him, who opens Supreme TV in Week 3 of July 2008 with a warning that judgment is coming to the Supreme Wrestling Federation and repeats it on SWF Legends and on Supreme TV in the weeks after; he tells Richard Eisen that he works for someone in the company's employ who is not Phil Vibert, and that Judgment Day will begin at Welcome to the Jungle 2008.

name: RK Hayes
caption: The large bodyguard billed beside Adrian Garcia in the Judgment Day introductions, who stands in the shadows behind him and never speaks.

name: Rhino Umaga
caption: A monster Samoan, brought out by BJ O'Neill beside Akima Brave in the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier on SWF Legends in July 2008, whom The Fry Report names as Akima's brother and the newest member of the Samoan Family; he dominates that match with his size but his team loses, and he loses to Steve Frehley on SWF Legends in Week 1 of August.

name: Erik Strong
caption: A 22-year-old newcomer whom The Fry Report calls a wrestler with tremendous upside, squashed by Brandon James on SWF Legends in Week 3 of July 2008, who teams with Mainstream Hernandez in the Sky Club tag tournament qualifier and is pinned by Paul Huntingdon, and falls to Pistol Pete Hall on Generation Supreme.

name: Narato
caption: Ota's partner in The Tokyo Underground, named by Duane Fry when the team debuts on SWF Legends in Week 3 of July 2008, a super junior who is pinned by Elmo Benson in the Sky Club ladder match and loses to The New Wave a week later.

name: Paul Steadyfast
caption: A veteran on an extended tryout with the SWF who has yet to impress, pinned by Kirk Jameson on Generation Supreme in Week 4 of July 2008.

name: Adam Matravers
caption: A youngster who, with Remmy Skye, loses to the ageless Steve Flash on Generation Supreme in Week 4 of July 2008.

name: Pistol Pete Hall
caption: A big cowboy who spent much of his career in Japan with Golden Canvas Grappling, a legend within the business as a trainer and road agent more than to the fans, who wins his first SWF match on Generation Supreme in Week 4 of July 2008 and is introduced by Phil Vibert on SWF Legends in Week 1 of August as a challenger for Bloodstone's Legends belt, losing by submission; the narrator and Vibert then persuade him to take a fuller schedule. He beats Texas Pete on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008, loses to Troy Tornado in an impromptu match in Week 3, beats Paul Huntingdon in Week 4 and Runaway Train in Week 1 of September, and asks Rich Money, who calls him 'Pissy Petey', for a match; the Fry Report bills him opposite Money for the World Heavyweight Championship on Supreme TV in Week 2 of September.

name: Sara Silver
caption: A tall brunette sports agent in a women's business suit who tells Emma Chase on SWF Legends in Week 1 of August 2008 that she is her competition and that The Silverbacks are coming, then turns down Badd Kompany's offer to manage them because her client takes all her time. She joins the Supreme TV announce table in Week 4 of August 2008 and, after Vengeance wrecks an interview set, says on SWF Legends that she may have a suggestion for what to do with him.

name: Mr. Jackson
caption: Sara Silver's large personal protection, who follows her out of the interview with Badd Kompany.

name: Alex DeColt
caption: The narrator's former trainer, who runs a training camp and a promotion with his family, and who phones the narrator after Supreme TV in Week 4 of July 2008 to complain that the SWF keeps signing his talent; the narrator offers to raise it with Richard Eisen.

name: Remmington Remus
caption: A man at a Supreme brand house show in July 2008 who pokes his head into the narrator's makeshift office to hand him a faxed letter.

name: Craig Prince
caption: The road agent for a Supreme brand house show in July 2008, who stands with the narrator at the Crippler Position and says a young wrestler really looks like he has it.

name: Acid
caption: A short, stocky masked high-flier, a former DaVE star who has worked in Japan, whom Eric Tyler springs on SWF Legends in Week 2 of August 2008 as a third man in Kid Toma's Shooting Star Championship defence against Bart Biggz; he wins the belt at Welcome to the Jungle 2008 in his first pay-per-view match with the Acid Rain Bomb, and keeps it on SWF Legends against El Leon and Mainstream Hernandez, Remmy Skye and John Greed. Tyler names him the first of his watchmen and the pillar of the Sky Club Division, and the narrator notes that the little tank has the deepest voice imaginable.

name: Payne
caption: A masked monster of some 6'9" and 350 pounds, in a leather strap mask with blood-red eyes, whom Adrian Garcia introduces at Welcome to the Jungle 2008 with the words 'Judgment Day begins now'; he chokeslams Troy Tornado, is disqualified against Chris Morrisette for tossing the referee, squashes Swoop McCarthy on Supreme TV in Week 3 of August 2008, and in Week 1 of September beats Darryl Devine and attacks him after the bell until Troy Tornado makes the save. The narrator's post-show entry recounts that the man under the mask left a decade of headlining Total Championship Wrestling to take the part.

caption: A veteran technician from Danger and Violence Extreme, one of Eric Tyler's watchmen, who debuts on SWF Legends in Week 3 of August 2008 in a Supreme Championship match with Christian Faith and loses; he teams with JD Morgan as The Watchmen, and in Week 1 of September brawls with Ray Diaz, with whom he has a history from Japan, through a Mass Effect tag match.

name: Donnie J
